items.title: Code Is Cheap. Judgment Isn't.
items.summary: In episode 1023 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Aishwarya Srinivasan, Co-Founder of The Gen Academy about how the cost of building code has become cheap with AI, shifting the bottleneck from execution to the crucial judgment of software engineering fundamentals. She explains that while AI tools make code generation easier, true AI builders need a deep understanding of engineering principles to create robust, production-ready applications. This shift means that foundational knowledge, rather than manual coding, is now the key to success.

items.title: The Biggest Mistake Teams Make with Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary:
What’s the biggest mistake teams make when introducing autonomous agents? Focusing on the technology before defining the system’s purpose, boundaries, and accountability.

In this short, the author of Architecting for Autonomy explains what teams often get wrong—and why successful agentic AI requires more than a capable model.

Learn more about Architecting for Autonomy:
